description:
Solve it once. From then on, your AI knows. cachly is memory for coding assistants over MCP: it stores a lesson after a fix and recalls it when the same problem returns. Hosted on EU servers; works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline and Zed.

124 tools in total; 27 are listed by default (the rest run through one dispatcher, cachly_tool).

Setup that also writes the rule files your assistant reads: npx @cachly-dev/mcp-server@latest autopilot
